ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as the ratifying source named by LLP 0000
disputeAdjudicator: Charlie Cheever; a disputed gate interpretation is resolved by a dated LLP 0063 amendment before rerun

environment.packageIdentity: Each receipt records every surface lockfile digest and resolved package name/version; aliases are reported as aliases, never normalized away.
environment.hardwareClass: apple-silicon-arm64; exact OS build, CPU model, and memory are recorded per run
environment.agentPrompt: Implement one manifest-named cell from the same clean fixture and guide context; no cross-cell transcript reuse.
environment.credentialCustodian: Charlie Cheever; secrets remain in .agent-local-secrets.md and receipts record only named health outcomes

deterministicChecks.aggregation: all required assertions pass; a skip is not a pass

stochasticMeasurements.outlierPolicy: retain all valid samples; invalidate only a documented instrument failure

sampling.timingTolerance: Contract p95 must be at or below the formula-derived threshold; equality passes
sampling.remoteDependency: Credential health is preflighted. An unhealthy remote cell is a receipt-recorded remote-dependency skip, excluded from local gate aggregation and never counted as pass.

nonInferiority.visualQuality: All registered semantic and visual-baseline claims pass at the same themes/viewports. Critical accessibility or layout failures have zero tolerance; image review is against the shared product specification, not React pixel identity.
nonInferiority.interactionDesign: The same claim IDs pass with no extra mandatory navigation/reboot step and no waived keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, or screen-reader claim.
nonInferiority.runtimeWeight: Each numeric category uses the formulas below against the same-workload React×Snapback baseline.
nonInferiority.diagnostics: Contract scores at least 90/100 and no lower than React on the frozen rubric.
nonInferiority.deploymentErgonomics: All scripted clean-checkout milestones pass, manual interventions are zero, and required command count is no more than React plus one.
nonInferiority.agentEffort: For the pinned configuration, median turns and tool calls are no more than 1.10× React; human interventions are no greater than React. A mixed result fails unless every worse dimension stays within its margin and Contract wins at least one dimension.

futureCategoriesDeadline: All remaining Workstream 8 categories join prospectively by Step 4 entry with dated holdout validation.

changePolicy.validBaseline: Never loosen or replace an ID; later amendments may tighten or add a holdout-validated metric.
changePolicy.invalidBaseline: Preserve original artifacts; document the instrument defect and impact; obtain ratifier approval; version-bump method and threshold IDs; rerun both comparison arms and controls prospectively. The replacement may move either direction.
changePolicy.unavailableInstrument: Document the loss; preserve the old artifacts; version-bump IDs; name the replacement environment/configuration; rerun both arms and controls prospectively.
changePolicy.workloadRollover: A new immutable workload version is declared before measurement; never rewrite an old workload baseline.
